_comment: Identities for the golden QA run (evals/run_qa.py). 'steward' holds 'brain-admins' (the unrestricted group: it sees every page, including the sales-scoped ones) and answers the answerable questions. 'analyst' holds NO group, so it reads every open page and nothing else — the acl-probe questions target sales-scoped pages, which are correctly out of scope and must be refused with no existence leak. Open is the ABSENCE of a label (ADR 045 D7), so an empty group list is the right spelling for a plain authenticated reader.
